name: Tough
description:
Your maximum Endurance is instead 6 times your BODY score.

At any time during combat, as a free action, you may spend 2 Endurance to gain 1 MP.

Describe how you throw yourself into battle.

improvements.name: Measured Step
improvements.description: At the beginning of each of your turns, you may choose to reduce your Speed for 1 round. For each 5 ft you reduce it by, ignore 5 lbs of weight from the equipment you're carrying when calculating Load.

improvements.name: Mighty
improvements.description: Each time you roll damage for a melee attack, instead of adding your BODY score to the result, add twice your BODY score.
